sources.title: GitHub - LibreTranslate/LTEngine: Local AI Machine Translation. Powered ...
sources.snippet: Free and Open Source Local AI Machine Translation API, written in Rust, entirely self-hosted and compatible with LibreTranslate. Its translation capabilities are powered by large language models (LLMs) that run locally on your machine via llama.cpp. The LLMs in LTEngine are much larger than the lightweight transformer models in LibreTranslate.
